I run a monthly tech meetup, 80 people in the room, and I want to replace the show of hands with a live poll. Build me this, all of it, in one go:

1) A host screen: I type a question and a few options, hit 'Open voting', and a big bar chart shows the results.
2) An audience screen that people open on their phones: they see the question and the options as big buttons, they tap one, done.
3) The results must update LIVE on every screen while votes come in — I'm projecting the bar chart and I want people to literally watch the bars grow as the room votes. No refresh.
4) One vote per person. Same phone shouldn't be able to vote twice on the same question.
5) I close the vote ('Close voting') and the final result stays on screen, bars frozen, and it says voting closed.
6) I can start the next question straight after, and I want to keep the history of the earlier questions from the evening, with their final results, so I can scroll back.

I'm going to test it with two browser frames side by side on this canvas, one as host and one as somebody in the audience, so make sure it works with two separate windows at the same time. Tell me when it's ready and how I switch a window between host and audience.
